description: Single storey rear extensions involving the demolition of existing WC, utility and garden room, replacement of windows and restoration of the front entrance porch.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Existing Site and Location Plan 1513 P 000 00 A Existing and Proposed Site Plan 1513 P 100 00 B 20.08.25Existing Ground Floor Plan 1513 P 100 01 B 20.08.25Existing First Floor Plan 1513 P 100 02 B 20.08.25Existing Loft Plan 1513 P 100 03 B 20.08.25Existing Roof Plan 1513 P 100 04 B 20.08.25Existing and Proposed West & North Elevations 1513 P 010 05 B 20.08.25Existing and Proposed East and South Elevations 1513 P 010 06 B 20.08.25Existing and Proposed Long & Cross Sections 1513 P 010 07 B 20.08.25Proposed Ground Floor Plan 1513 P 010 01 B 20.08.25Proposed First Floor Plan 1513 P 010 02 B 20.08.25Proposed Loft Plan 1513 P 010 03 B 20.08.25Proposed Roof Plan 1513 P 010 04 B 20.08.25Proposed Front Porch 1513 P 010 08 B 20.08.25Proposed Front Porch 1513 P 010 09 A June 2025Proposed Front Elevation Casement Windows 1513 P 600 01 A 18.08.25Proposed Front Elevation Sash Window Details 1513 P 600 02 A August 2025Design and Access Statement and Heritage Statement 20.08.25Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and preserve the character of the conservation area.
